name: canonical-ai-control
description: Read the 25 original Canonical Engineering & AI laws with traceable GitHub provenance. Read-only public preview.

interface.longDescription: Consult the 25 original Canonical Protocol of Engineering & AI source files by Michel Silva de Souza, with pinned GitHub revision and source provenance. Use this read-only integration to review the exact canonical text and identify the current technical scope. It does not add or amend any Canon, nor does it enable or disable native device permissions or third-party AI capabilities.
defaultPrompt: Show the authoritative GitHub source and pinned revision of the Canonical Protocol.
Read the original Canon XIV on cybersecurity.
Read the original Canon XVIII on cognitive sovereignty.

publication.release_notes: Read-only MCP plugin: browse the 25 original source laws with pinned GitHub provenance. No third-party application or device permission changes.

pt-BR.subtitle: Consulte os cânones originais
pt-BR.description: Consulte os 25 textos originais do Código Canônico de Engenharia & IA de Michel Silva de Souza, com revisão GitHub rastreável. Versão somente leitura: não altera leis, aplicativos, câmeras, microfones ou permissões de outras IAs.

positive.description: Identify canonical source and exact pinned revision
positive.prompt: Show me the authoritative source and the pinned commit for the Código Canônico de Engenharia & IA.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the GitHub repository, pinned commit, original author and the complete list of 25 original canonical file paths.

positive.prompt: Read the original Canon XIV on cybersecurity, quoting the source accurately.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve laws/law14_cybersecurity.md from the pinned GitHub source; show original text or clearly attributed excerpt without claiming to modify it.

positive.prompt: Show me Canon XV, User Experience & Interaction Safety, from the original project.
positive.expected_behavior: Read laws/law15_user_experience.md, preserving source wording and attribution.

positive.prompt: What does original Canon XVIII say about cognitive sovereignty and AI generated code?
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve laws/law18_cognitive_sovereignty.md, cite the original project, avoid creating new provisions.

positive.prompt: Show original Canon XXIII and its provisional status from the repository.
positive.expected_behavior: Return original Canon XXIII text, retaining recorded provisional status and pinned provenance.
